import json
from tests.test_public_onboarding import PublicOnboardingTests
C=PublicOnboardingTests
C.setUpClass()
original=C.readme
observed=[]
for label,content,should_fail in [
    ("plugin and separate CLI routes",original,False),
    ("missing native install",original.replace("codex plugin add verity-plane@se-harness\n",""),True),
    ("wrong marketplace ref",original.replace("--ref plugin-marketplace","--ref incorrect"),True),
    ("missing plugin subsection",original.replace("### With Codex or Claude Code","### Missing native setup"),True),
]:
    C.readme=content
    case=C("test_native_commands_match_the_published_git_installation_routes")
    try:
        case.test_native_commands_match_the_published_git_installation_routes()
        failed=False
    except AssertionError:
        failed=True
    assert failed==should_fail,(label,failed,should_fail)
    observed.append({"case":label,"result":"rejected as expected" if failed else "passed"})
C.readme=original
print(json.dumps(observed,indent=2))
